about: A native client drawing on the GPU (ADR 0031): tools/oxyos-gpu-client renders with Vulkan into DMA-BUFs it exports, attaches them plane by plane, and submits each frame with an acquire point (its submission's completion) and a release point it waits for before drawing into a buffer again. Run it with the client as `--client` (regress.py --client target/release/oxyos-gpu-client) where a render node has timeline syncobjs and DMA-BUFs can be made (tools/gpu-vm/gpu-vm; the ThinkPad); with neither, it draws into shared memory and the frames' expectations fail. Its window is blue with a white square and a dark bar until a press makes it orange, green after another; a configure answered by a frame of another size, or a frame that never took the GPU path, fails it.

steps.name: a press: the frame answering it drawn on the GPU in another of its buffers, latched once its acquire point signalled
another press: a buffer released and drawn into again
the right edge resized 100 px out at a hand's pace: every configure answered by a frame of its size drawn into new buffers, the other edges still
